text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Witness the birth of a new star in Make Debut!
Which horse girl will shine the brightest?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Go for it!
Keep it up, keep it up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With sparse cheers at my back,
I clutched my hands together, watching over the debut race as if in prayer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this racing heartbeat from excitement?
Or is it tension from sending off my trainee for the first time?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The me that you're going to raise,
I feel like I'm going to become a whole new person!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulling her hands to her chest, she pressed them firmly.
...She could not take her eyes off this race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to respond to the earnest trust she places in me.
I want to be the force that pushes her forward.
choice_data_list: (How are you, Tsuyoshi? How is your body—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if her constitution has flaws.
So that she may sprint toward her aspirations—!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Kuh...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My fingertips are burning. My face is burning.
My entire body is screaming at me to run.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Still, it doesn't hurt! There's no pain!
I can run! I can run!! I can run!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOAAAH!
I am Tsuyoshi! Tsurumaru Tsuyoshiiiii!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah... *clap clap clap*...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
Haa... Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was able to run with all my might!!
In an official race! In my Make Debut!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a truly great run!
Yeah, that was a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Nngh! Trainer.
I'll keep following you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Let's aim for it: Triple Crown Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The air trapped in my chest escapes my lips.
That's right—we'll definitely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if her constitution is weak, even if she can't handle the same regimen as other Umamusume.
If we can just prepare a path tailored to her..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything will definitely work out." Bruges},
  {"id": 41, "en": ""Something extraordinary,
that will never be forgotten."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —...Or so it was supposed to be!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Excuuuuse meee, Traiiineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi blundered...!
Regrettably, training must come to a halt...!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
A specialist was called in earlier for an initial examination.
It's not a broken bone,
so it's hard to tell just by looking, but...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. Come over here for a moment.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san herself seems in good spirits,
but there's swelling around her ankle.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Please make sure she doesn't push herself under any circumstances this week. Even just bearing weight on both legs must be agonizing.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't know what caused this.
She's always been prone to swelling, but...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...This is likely a matter of her constitution.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
You might recover by next week and be able to train,
but... please proceed with caution.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a symptom I had never seen before.
choice_data_list: (I've never seen anything like that, even in training...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symptoms that never showed during training.
Then the cause must lie—in the race itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who step onto the track pour their very lives into a battle of mere minutes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The fierce jostling, the tension of running before the crowd.
They slammed their feet against the turf with all their might."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's different from training.
Because victory and defeat are on the line, the race grinds away at their bodies. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I let her keep running like this—what will become of her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...*Gulp*. I swallow my saliva.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand what she carries on her shoulders.
I understand the idol she longs to chase after, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And yet, why now of all times are my hands trembling—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I saw your back, Trainer.
So I came to brag a little!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Actually, just a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—I made Spe-chan and the others
admit they were frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "‘Who would've thought Tsuru-chan would be the first to debut?’ ‘Guess she's the most senior among us,’ they said."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Saying, "I won't lose either."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—See, isn't it amazing!?
I'm one step ahead of everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So you can do it next time too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"And also an Umamusume who is
'absolutely fine' even if she runs!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We managed to get proper results this time.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"If we continue to put in the 'right effort' like this,
you'll definitely be fine next time!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl before my eyes smiles brightly.
So dazzling... and so very, very strong.
choice_data_list: (Even though she was faced with a situation where she couldn't run...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though she must have been more terrified than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just looking straight ahead.
Thinking about what's next. Seeking out what I can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. That is so.
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi is a strong girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She isn't the kind of girl
to freeze up out of fear of moving forward.
choice_data_list: ...Ngh, I see. 'Everything will definitely be fine,' huh.
...Ngh, right. 'Everything will definitely be fine,' huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you've got time to mope,
—then think for yourself too. Try things out. Push yourself to the absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What good am I as a Trainer
if I end up becoming dead weight to her?
choice_data_list: Next time, I swear I'll protect your legs and your running!
Next time, I'll definitely protect your legs and your running too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, yes! Please, go ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who swore to make her a Triple Crown Umamusume...
The one who took charge of her—was me.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Examining Tsuyoshi Tsurumaru-san
on a weekly basis...?
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry to bother you when you're busy, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is still time until the Classic Triple Crown.
If so, let's monitor her condition and enter her in whichever races she can run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown races are all GⅠ races.
Results are necessary
just to qualify for entry, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And we shall now begin our conditioning for the coming spring!!
